# Sal's Barbershop

> One-chair barbershop based in Austin, Texas. Consistent classic cuts, honest advice about your hair and good conversation at 4809 S Congress Ave, from the barber his regulars followed from Avenue Barber Shop.

- Phone: (512) 525-5632
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Google rating: 4.8 from 65 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/sals-barbershop/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/sals-barbershop/book.html

## Services
- Classic haircuts: A clean, classic cut, done right and done the same way every time you sit down.
- Textured & tricky hair: Coarse, curly or textured hair and odd growth patterns, handled with ease.
- Honest hair advice: Sal tells you straight what will work for your hair and what won't.

## About
Sal's Barbershop is a one-chair shop at 4809 S Congress Ave in South Austin: a dark-wood kiosk with a red-and-white striped awning, a barber pole by the door and a big BARBER sign out front. The roadside sign says it plainly: EST 2025. Sal (Salvador Vasquez on his booking page) built a following at Avenue Barber Shop, and a lot of his regulars came with him when he struck out on his own. They keep coming back every few weeks for the same reasons: the cut is consistent, he is honest about what works for your hair and what doesn't, and textured or tricky hair is no problem. Sal is a former schoolteacher, so the conversation is half the visit: history, current events, sports and stories from the '80s and '90s. You might leave with a fresh cut and something new to think about.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 12 PM to 7 PM, Saturday 8 AM to 3 PM, closed Sunday. Call (512) 525-5632 to check Wednesdays and holidays.
- Q: Where is the shop, and where do I park?
  A: 4809 S Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78745. Look for the wood kiosk with the red-and-white striped awning, the barber pole and the BARBER sign. Parking is free in back, or on the grass by the sidewalk.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on Sal's Vagaro page (there's a QR code on the sign out front too) or call (512) 525-5632. If something comes up, please cancel at least an hour ahead so someone else can take the spot.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: Cash and Venmo.
- Q: Can Sal cut textured or curly hair?
  A: Yes. Regulars with textured hair and tricky growth patterns say he handles it with ease and they never have to explain twice.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes, kids are welcome in the chair. Book them on Vagaro like any other cut.
- Q: Who cuts my hair?
  A: Sal does. It's a one-chair shop, so you get the same master barber every visit.
